# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Mar 11, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on critical bug fixes in the Kona derivation pipeline, enhancements to the Supernode functionality, and general infrastructure improvements. Several issues related to pipeline stability and error handling were resolved, alongside updates to the op-reth dependency.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Kona Derivation Pipeline Stability and Error Handling
Significant effort was put into improving the robustness of the Kona derivation pipeline. This included fixing issues where blob under-fills caused critical pipeline halts, now returning a `Reset` error instead of `Critical` ([#19362](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19362)). Bounds checks were added to span batch decode functions to prevent panics on truncated input ([#19361](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19361)), and a bug where the `origin` field was not copied during the `BatchQueue` to `BatchValidator` transition was resolved ([#19360](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19360)). Additionally, system config update failures in L1Traversal are now non-fatal ([#19358](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19358)).

### Supernode and Devstack Enhancements
The Supernode functionality saw updates, including replacing the supervisor with supernode in the VM runner and adding a new `superroot_syncStatus` RPC endpoint ([#19438](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19438)). P2P configuration for supernode follow mode CLs was also added to op-devstack ([#19439](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19439)).

### Infrastructure and Dependency Updates
A critical CI fix was implemented to add passthrough parameters, resolving issues with manual pipeline dispatch ([#19462](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19462)). The `op-reth` dependency was bumped to version 1.11.2, incorporating an important security patch ([#19472](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19472)). The core team was also renamed from "platforms-team" ([#19436](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19436)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- [#19487](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19487) feat(rust): karst-derive inlined derivation pipeline
- [#19486](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19486) chore: add nut bundle check to just pr
- [#19484](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19484) Rv fuzzing setup
- [#19483](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19483) chore(cannon): migrate testdata Makefiles to justfiles
- [#19482](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19482) ci: update CircleCI config to use just instead of make
- [#19481](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19481) refactor(kona/derive): rename index to expected_blobs in BlobData::fill
- [#19479](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19479) chore(deps): bump hono from 4.11.7 to 4.12.7 in /rust/docs

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Kona Derivation Pipeline Bug Fixes
Several critical issues in the Kona derivation pipeline were resolved. This includes fixing a fatal system config update failure ([#19353](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19353)), addressing the missing `origin` field copy during `BatchProvider.attempt_update()` on Holocene transition ([#19356](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19356)), and correcting the `BlobData::fill` behavior to return `Reset` instead of `Critical` on blob under-fill ([#19359](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19359)).

### Supernode and Acceptance Test Improvements
Issues related to the `op-supernode` and acceptance tests were closed. This includes updating the VM runner to use the supernode ([#18669](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18669)), introducing a `SyncStatus` API for `op-supernode` ([#18947](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18947)), and fixing L2 CL P2P connection for light CLs in follow-mode ([#19379](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19379)).

### CI/CD and Docker Workflow Enhancements
Improvements to the CI/CD pipeline were implemented, including resolving sporadic acceptance test timeouts ([#18261](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18261)) and removing the unnecessary Sign step from the Docker publishing workflow ([#18558](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18558)).

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were opened today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES
No active issues with more than 3 comments.
